title: STILL HERE A: PRECISION IGNITION (V2)
description: A 12-second aerospace spec score. 120 BPM in A: a Tempo String statement answered by a talkbox in the same 3+3+2 rhythm; the cable spools up, the factory breathes for 125 ms, and ignition lands on 4.000 s (frame 176,400).

tracks.description: The dormant press: MORPH household clank tuned to A2 over a membrane thump; one per second, then the 11.75 s lock.
MORPH//04 membrane kick: four on the floor from ignition; bigger hits at 4.0, 10.0 and 11.0 s.
MORPH//04 membrane snare with a cable crack tuned to A3; the climb roll.
Cable ticks in 16ths accenting the 3+3+2 hook rhythm; the ratchet follows the spool; cable scrape off-beats.
Cable toms climbing G-A-B-C# into the payoff.
Struck steel plate (stereo: different modes per side) at ignition, payoff and final, on its own track.
EXTERNAL: the Tempo String bass performance above 110 Hz (driven presence + body).
EXTERNAL: the same performance below 110 Hz; authored gain ducks it under every kick.
EXTERNAL: a second cable wound from an eighth-note round trip into A1 (3.0-3.875 s), then grabbed to exact silence.
EXTERNAL: the talkbox answer, a saw driving the MORPH Kelly-Lochbaum throat (wa-ow-yeah).
EXTERNAL: the talkbox harmony in the climb and payoff.
EXTERNAL: MORPH FDN room return of lead + harmony.
Saw-ensemble brass stabs: A at ignition, D push, F and G in the climb, A payoff, A(add9) final.
Cable-pluck arpeggio, an octave above the voice (precision components): accents from ignition, 16ths from 6.0 s.
Glass tines: the robot answer at 1.0 s and the final sparkle.
